challenge.method: Follow the §5.4.3.9 variable path across the page break after coercion. Test all four old/new Nothing combinations, and compare the neighboring Property Set and Property Let wording.
challenge.results: Old Nothing suppresses detachment and new Nothing suppresses attachment, independently. The adjacent property branch has different static/runtime wording and cannot affect the variable path. No conclusion about dispatch timing follows.

limitations: This judgment applies to the exact May 20, 2025 MS-VBAL revision 2.4. The publisher currently lists a later edition. Its requirements and behavior of any Office host are outside this review.
The conclusion concerns a valid Set operation on a WithEvents variable, excluding assignments classified as properties and event scheduling by the host.
